name: ClearGlass Multi-Agent Workflow Prototype

agents.name: Intake Agent
agents.role: Receives business task and extracts objective, constraints, inputs, outputs, owner, and deadline.

agents.name: Planner Agent
agents.role: Breaks the intake brief into ordered execution steps with dependencies and acceptance criteria.

agents.name: Executor Agent
agents.role: Performs the planned work or drafts the required implementation artifact.

agents.name: Auditor Agent
agents.role: Checks the artifact for errors, missing assumptions, security gaps, compliance risks, and operational drift.

agents.name: Logger Agent
agents.role: Records execution result, decisions, success metric, blockers, and next action for reuse tomorrow.

reusable_tomorrow_instruction: Change raw_business_task and rerun the same five-stage sequence. Preserve result logs by date.
